detail.longDescription: An LLM judge that repeated its own verdict 98.2% of the time agreed with tau2-bench's native scoring on 56.2% of 2,160 episodes. In 11 labeled episodes the agent made a write the policy forbade. The judge passed 10 to 11. A reasoning judge passed 6; given the policy it caught all 11 but failed 40 of 55 fully correct runs. A rule with no model call (did a write commit on a no-write task?) caught all 11. https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.14581 # AIAgents # MachineLearning # LLMEval
